description: KNaV₆(PbO₃)₈ crystallizes in the trigonal P3 space group. K is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.74-3.09 Å. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.53 Å) and three longer (2.89 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four PbO₆ pentagonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one PbO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-1.77 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four PbO₆ pentagonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one PbO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-1.76 Å. There are four inequivalent Pb sites. In the first Pb site, Pb is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted PbO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent PbO₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with four VO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Pb-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.77 Å. In the second Pb site, Pb is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted PbO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent PbO₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with four VO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Pb-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.78 Å. In the third Pb site, Pb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Pb-O bond lengths are 2.41 Å. In the fourth Pb site, Pb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Pb-O bond lengths are 2.43 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one K, one V, and two Pb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and two Pb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, one V, and one Pb atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one Pb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one K, one V, and two Pb atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one V and two Pb atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one V and two Pb atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one V and two Pb atoms.
